suite.name: Fixed plus-48-hour routing-window study across all baseline and holdout events

parameter_policy: No calibration. Every extended case preserves its baseline solver, geometry, roughness, grid, warm-up, and forcing rules.

cases.name: Glen Canyon Dam to Lees Ferry — 2004-07-01 — extended by 48 hours

terrain_representation.name: ribbon
terrain_representation.limitation: Laterally uniform constant-width numerical ribbon; configured longitudinal width variation is not represented and this is not mapped flood terrain.

reach_context.window_extension_policy: Append the same fixed duration to the pre-existing scored end; no parameter or endpoint is selected from model skill.

volume_only_counterfactual.guard: Uses held-out downstream volume as an oracle diagnostic. It is not a permissible forcing correction or calibration.

reach_diagnosis.guard: Volume change combines intervening flows, withdrawals, measurement error, and net reach-storage change; it is not a calibrated lateral flow.
